description: List the quick fixes and refactorings available for a range of a document, each with the edits it would make. Nothing is applied; write the edits with your own file tools or use the rename/format/apply_model_edit tools with apply=true.

path.description: the document, absolute or relative to the workspace root

range.description: the lines of interest (1-based); omitted, the whole document

end.description: character after the span (1-based line and column)

start.description: first character of the span (1-based line and column)

name: code_actions

changes.description: the edits the action makes, per document

edits.description: edits to the document's current text, non-overlapping, in document order

newText.description: the text that replaces the range; empty deletes it

end.description: character after the span (1-based line and column)

start.description: first character of the span (1-based line and column)

diagnostics.description: messages of the diagnostics the action addresses
